Name: Yet Another Auto Watering
Author: zhuoyun233
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#0CA335]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.11 and SMAPI 4.1.4.
现已支持中文[/color][/size][font=Comic Sans MS][size=6][color=#37D9F0]
Auto Watering
[/color][/size][/font][/b][list]
[*]This mod waters all your crops when they are planted and every day thereafter. It also works on [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Garden_Pot]Garden Pots[/url]﻿.
[*]This mod can also be configured to automatically apply [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fertilizer]fertilizer[/url]﻿ to all your crops. (Disabled by default. See Configuration)
[*]An unofficial migration of the old mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5463][b]Autowatering[/b][/url]﻿[b] [/b]by @stellarashes
[/list] [b][size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "Stardew Valley/Modes".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5][u]Features[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Automatically water[/b] all your crops, including Greenhouse and indoor Pots.
[*][b]Automatically fertilize [/b]all your crops if you want, easily choose the type of fertilize.
[*]Water all your crops with just [b]one click[/b].
[*]Choose which days to water, save yourself a relaxing weekend.
[*]Intuitive configuration interface in Generic Mod Config Menu.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21036/21036-1711455943-309233284.png[/img]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=6][color=#37D9F0][b]Plans
[/b][/color][/size][/font][list]
[*]Automatically water all your crops. ✔
[*]Automatically apply fertilizer to all crops. ✔
[*]Allow configurable days when watering takes place.✔
[*]In game configuration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].✔
[*]Chinese Translation 中文汉化.✔
[/list]
